decisions.why: Bokang Sphygmomanometers are general BP monitors (monitoring:gen); Welch Allyn NIBP Cuffs are sensor/probe accessories (monitoring:sens).
Digital/Character Thermometers are general monitoring devices; Proact Temperature Probes are sensors/probes.
Nonin Handheld/Tabletop Pulse Oximeters are specialist monitors; Sensors Cables Accessories are monitoring:sens.
Disposable/Reusable Forceps, Anaesthetic Masks and Shears are general theatre consumables.
Nonin Respsense and Creative 900B are dedicated capnography monitors - specialist monitoring devices.
Nonin 2120 SpO2/NIBP and Creative PC 900Pro/3000 are multi-parameter specialist patient monitors.
